components.purpose: The sole component needed for this request — an opening/top-of-page hero banner (Heading, Description, CTAs, background styling) that includes a built-in 'Personalization' tab with a nested list of Personalized Hero Items, each tied to an audience. This is used to define the default banner text plus an audience-specific variant for 'Europe' and another for 'North America', so the same banner automatically swaps its heading/description text based on the visitor's region.
